SQL:
WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers.id AS "customers.id",
    customers.tier AS "customers.tier"
  FROM customers AS customers
  GROUP BY
    customers.id,
    customers.tier
), _cm_customers__orders__iif_orders_status_ok_1_0_sum AS (
  SELECT
    orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    SUM(CASE WHEN orders.status = 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "orders.iif_status_ok_1_0_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  GROUP BY
    orders.customer_id,
    customers.tier
), __slayer_stage_per_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.tier" AS "tier",
    _stage_inner."customers.ok_orders" AS "ok_orders"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."customers.id",
      _base_2."customers.tier",
      _cm_customers__orders__iif_orders_status_ok_1_0_sum."orders.iif_status_ok_1_0_sum" AS "customers.ok_orders"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__iif_orders_status_ok_1_0_sum
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__iif_orders_status_ok_1_0_sum."orders.customer_id"
      AND _base_2."customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__iif_orders_status_ok_1_0_sum."orders.customers.tier"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "per_cust.n",
  COUNT(DISTINCT per_cust.id) AS "per_cust.nd"
FROM __slayer_stage_per_cust AS per_cust
WHERE
  (
    per_cust.tier = 'bronze' OR per_cust.ok_orders > 0
  )
LIMIT 21
